name: Dowa Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: Dowa Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the environmental management and recycling, nonferrous metals, electronic materials, metal processing, and heat treatment businesses. The company offers Incineration of industrial waste; landfilling of waste; melting and recycling of incinerated ash; surveys and remediation of soil; environmental consulting; recycling of metal and discarded household appliances; and treatment of automotive shredder dust services. It also provides gold, silver, copper, lead, tin, antimony, nickel sulfate, zinc, zinc alloys, indium, and sulfuric acid metals; recycling of platinum-group metals; and resource and raw material procurement services.
